title: Meaning of the less-than-or-equal condition
statement: For a state $\sigma$ and expressions $a,b$, the condition written $a\le' b$ holds in $\sigma$ if and only if the value of $a$ in $\sigma$ is at most the value of $b$ in $\sigma$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the notation $\le'$, so its intended condition constructor cannot be identified from the ground-truth text alone.
